description: Big spiny rosette of the Pampas grassland, throwing up a branched flowering stalk well above the leaves. A structure plant rather than a pretty one.
nativeStatus: Native to the Pampas and neighbouring grasslands
ecology: A grassland rosette that holds water at its base and creates a protected pocket at ground level. In open country these rosettes are where a lot of small animal life shelters.
wildlifeNotes: The rosette gives ground-level cover that grassland birds use, and its dried leaf fibre is taken for nest building. The flowering stalks feed insects, then set seed.
size: Rosette to about 1 m across, flowering stalk taller
safety: The leaf edges and tips are genuinely sharp. Keep it well away from paths.
